Chapter 682 - 682 Leaving; Four Seasons Cosmos!

Chapter 682 - 682 Leaving; Four Seasons Cosmos!

682 Leaving; Four Seasons Cosmos!

At the same time, the cracks on the surface of the ancient door that had been washed by the spatial turbulence continued to spread.

In the end, the door turned into countless fragments and scattered casually.

After the door shattered previously, endless chaotic winds flowed through the shattered area and poured into Earth, wantonly destroying it.

But now, it was very peaceful.

Lin Fan walked out of the broken area and sensed the calm outside world. He muttered in his heart, ‘There seems to be no primal chaos astral winds here.’

He looked around carefully before returning to Earth.

At this moment, the tall buildings and the winding viaduct that were originally visible… disappeared.

What replaced it were dense rocks and endless ruins.

Wails, sighs, cries… They were endless.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s expression turned solemn.

Soon, he returned to the Coiling Dragon Villa in Jiangbei.

“Lin Fan!” Hu Tian, Xia Xue, Xia Bing, Huang Ling, and the others shouted happily when they saw that he was fine.

Lin Fan said, “I’m fine.”

As soon as he finished speaking, he could not help but frown slightly.

This time, he was fine.

What about the next time?

After experiencing everything that had happened in this period of time, Lin Fan realized that the dangers of this world were much greater than he had imagined.

He could deal with a monster.

But what about three of them? Or Six?

What if he met the archer?

Although he did not want to admit it, Lin Fan had to acknowledge that with his current strength, it would be difficult for him to deal with the dangers that might appear in the future.

At that time, how would he protect his family and loved ones?

How could this rare happiness continue to exist?

In his previous life, Lin Fan was a Chaos Dragon God. He ate, drank, and slept every day.

He had never thought of increasing his strength.

In this life, Lin Fan was a student and a professor. Every day, he would receive red packets, and his life was very comfortable.

At this moment, an urgent thought of improving his strength surged into his mind like a tide.

For the next few days, Lin Fan spent all his time with his lovers and family.

Coiling Dragon Villa was filled with happiness.

One day, after breakfast, Lin Fan said, “I’m preparing to go out and take a look.”

Silence!

The entire Coiling Dragon Villa immediately fell silent.

Even though Lin Fan did not say where he was going, everyone seemed to have guessed the place.

Outside Earth, in the chaos!

“When are you planning to go out?” Hu Tian asked after a while.

Lin Fan said, “Later.”

He knew that the longer it dragged on, the harder it would be for him to leave.

In addition, he did not know… when Earth would face another crisis.

The earlier he went out, the earlier he could obtain more power and better protect Earth.

The women opened their mouths as if they wanted to say something, but no words came out.

Hu Tian pursed her red lips and said, “Then be careful.”

Lin Fan nodded. “I will be careful.”

Then, he looked at everyone and said, “Everyone…Goodbye.”

As soon as he finished speaking, he took a step forward and instantly disappeared from where he was.

Seeing this…

The women could not hold it in any longer and shouted.

“Lin Fan, you must be careful!”

“Lin Fan, come back early!”

“We’ll wait for you at home!”

…

At this moment, Lin Fan followed the broken door and arrived in the void outside of Earth.

After creating a series of camouflage spells at the broken spot, he found a direction and kept moving forward through space jumps.

With each leap, Lin Fan could travel tens of thousands of kilometers.

After a thousand jumps, the void in the distance suddenly fluctuated.

Then, a two-meter-tall man gradually appeared.

The man’s aura was very unstable. When he saw Lin Fan, he was very alert.

When Lin Fan caught sight of him, his eyes lit up, and he charged toward him.

The man’s heart tightened. He wanted to dodge, but his body found it difficult to support himself.

“What business do you have?” he asked from afar.

When Lin Fan heard that, his eyes lit up.

That was because the other party was speaking Hua language!

Thus, Lin Fan said, “You seem to be injured. I happen to know some healing methods.”

As soon as he finished speaking, he did not wait for the other party to reply and directly shot out a ray of light of life.

The middle-aged man’s aura quickly stabilized.

At the same time, his expression softened.

The middle-aged man cupped his fists and said, “Thank you for your help. I am Tian Yang. May I know who you are?”

“I am Lin Fan,” Lin Fan said.

“So, your name is Lin Fan…” Tian Yang nodded.

His tone was calm.

However, there was still a hint of vigilance on his face.

Lin Fan was not too bothered by this.

It was not easy for him to encounter a human, so he had to seize the opportunity to ask.

Lin Fan said, “Tian Yang, may I know which region this is?”

“Lin Fan, have you never been here before?” Tian Yang asked. “This is the Spring Domain of the Four Seasons Cosmos.

“To be honest, my planet is completely sealed off. This is the first time I’ve come out of a planet,” Lin Fan said.

“So that’s how it is!” Tian Yang said in realization.

“Then, Lin Fan, you must take a good look around the Four Seasons Cosmos. This place is much bigger and livelier than a planet!”

Lin Fan nodded. “I think so too.”

Tian Yang looked at Lin Fan and said, “I think that you’re still very young. Have you considered going to the Heavenly Wind World?”

“Heavenly Wind World?” Lin Fan asked curiously.

Tian Yang saw that he was not pretending at all.

Thus, he continued, “The Heavenly Wind World is a very strange place. It opens once every 10,000 years. There are many opportunities inside. Only people below 10,000 years old can enter. Of course, it’s also very dangerous.”

Lin Fan said, “Thank you for your guidance, Tian Yang.”

The two of them chatted for a while more, then Tian Yang said that he had something to do and had to leave.

Lin Fan did not force him to stay. After all, they did not have much of a relationship. Staying would only make him more wary.

As for Lin Fan, he followed the direction pointed out by Tian Yang and continued forward.

After Lin Fan jumped through space a few hundred times, a faint green planet appeared not too far away.

Lin Fan leaped up and flew over.

This was a planet densely covered with green plants. High-rise buildings, bent roads, and aircraft could be seen everywhere.

Obviously, this was a planet with a high level of civilization.

Lin Fan had just appeared when a man in black flew to the side.

He bowed and respectfully said, “Greetings, Your Excellency.”

“Oh?” Lin Fan asked curiously. “You knew I was here?”

“We have a Heavenly Protection System on our planet,” the man said. “It can detect experts who have entered the planet…

“After the Star Lord knew that you were here, he first asked me to receive you. Then, he asked me to ask if we should arrange a grand welcoming ceremony?”

After he finished speaking, he lowered his head even more. He was very cautious and careful.
